meta.dataset: I-Cheng Yeh, "Modeling of strength of high performance concrete using artificial neural networks", Cement and Concrete Research 28(12), 1998; UCI ML Repository, Concrete Compressive Strength, CC BY 4.0
meta.selection: 5-fold CV (shuffled, seed 42) RMSE on the training split; refit on full training split; test evaluated once
meta.threshold_encoding: shortest decimal t' such that float32(x) <= t' iff float32(x) <= t for every float32 x (exact; leaf-index equality verified)
meta.inference: raw = init + lr * sum(leaf values); prediction = raw (MPa). Cast inputs to float32 before comparing; go left when x[f] <= t.
